hf_papers.abstract: A systematic framework shows that frontier multimodal models can serve as robot policies when harnessed with interfaces favoring native visual reasoning and tool use, achieving high success in simulated and real manipulation tasks.

hf_papers.title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
hf_papers.abstract: WorldLeague benchmarks 13 AI systems on 60 simulated robot tasks spanning exploration, rearrangement, and adaptation, measuring progress and success to compare autonomous physical goal achievement.

hf_papers.abstract: A code localizer is trained with scores from a frozen fixer via weighted supervised fine-tuning, improving bug localization and patch success for a small coding agent without tests or reinforcement learning.

hf_papers.title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
hf_papers.abstract: nanoAstra combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning to train vision-language models for generalizable robot manipulation, achieving strong zero-shot success and faster streaming execution.

hf_papers.title: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
hf_papers.abstract: A framework enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation policies without demonstrations by exploring and distilling successful attempts into a program, then refining it for strong simulated and real-world results.

hf_papers.title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
hf_papers.abstract: ViDecide trains video diffusion models to make causal state-transition and stopping decisions, using Corrective Fine-tuning to improve multi-step planning success without policy gradients.

hf_papers.title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
hf_papers.abstract: A benchmark assesses how well video generators follow animated 3D blockouts while preserving structure, filling missing content, correcting proxy artifacts, and binding multimodal conditions to the correct entities and events.

hf_papers.title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
hf_papers.abstract: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. hf_papers.abstract: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. hf_papers.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. hf_papers.title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
hf_papers.abstract: DocSEAM is a lightweight module between a pretrained vision encoder and language model that enriches page visual tokens with neighboring-page context via center-anchored masked self-attention, improving multi-page document VQA and reducing boundary sensitivity.

hf_papers.title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
hf_papers.abstract: StateWeaver improves long-video generation by preserving cross-shot consistency and updating visual references through active state tracking and hierarchical collaboration.

hf_papers.title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
hf_papers.abstract: Text-aware image super-resolution (TAISR) aims to recover high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs while preserving textual content. hf_papers.title: Beam Model Technical Report
hf_papers.abstract: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts language model optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads, using large-scale asynchronous reinforcement learning, long-context midtraining, quantization, and speculative decoding to deliver strong reasoning and safety with efficient inference.

hf_papers.title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
hf_papers.abstract: HOG-WAM improves visually robust control in world-action models by adding future Histograms of Oriented Gradients as auxiliary structural supervision through a training-only HOG diffusion transformer, yielding higher success under observation corruptions while preserving the original RGB-to-action inference architecture.

hf_papers.title: Qwen-Image-HD: Autoregressive Diffusion for High Definition Image Generation
hf_papers.abstract: Fine-tuning a generator on a complete high-resolution canvas requires long image sequences and substantial computation, yet local regions can still exhibit unnatural repetitive stripes when training resources are limited. hf_papers.title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
hf_papers.abstract: A fine-grained speculative streaming framework prepares action-conditioned video futures during playback to reduce input-to-display latency in interactive world models while sustaining real-time generation.

hf_papers.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
hf_papers.abstract: Integral converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space, preserving understanding while enabling strong visual generation.

hf_papers.title: Open Vision Banana: An Open Framework for Unified Visual Perception through Generation in RGB Space
hf_papers.abstract: Vision Banana showed that a closed image generator, instruction-tuned to paint perception outputs as RGB images, becomes a generalist vision model. Does this carry over to open generators, and if not, what fails? hf_papers.title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
hf_papers.abstract: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. hf_papers.title: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
hf_papers.abstract: UUBench assesses how well multimodal interactive systems understand and respond to users' implicit communicative needs through process- and outcome-oriented scoring grounded in observable audiovisual evidence.

hf_papers.title: Real2SimLab: A Unified Platform for Real-to-Simulation Transfer
hf_papers.abstract: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry. Recently, coding agents have become capable of generating simulation programs from video recordings, and several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate them. hf_papers.title: Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation
hf_papers.abstract: Preference fine-tuning based on Direct Preference Optimization adapts a pretrained part-aware 3D generator with limited part annotations, yielding the best multi-part results at medium scale but less consistent gains under distribution shift.

hf_papers.title: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
hf_papers.abstract: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. hf_papers.title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
hf_papers.abstract: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. hf_papers.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
hf_papers.abstract: Models can use deep latent reasoning to pursue hidden objectives while generating chain-of-thought explanations that appear task-appropriate and evade output-based monitoring.

hf_papers.title: DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations
hf_papers.abstract: Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. hf_papers.title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
hf_papers.abstract: A training-free framework tracks objects through physical assemblies and disassemblies by generating and evaluating split/merge proposals and querying a multimodal large language model for verification and labeling, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and faster performance on a new benchmark.

hf_papers.title: Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures
hf_papers.abstract: Training world models on simulated manipulation failures with interaction alignment and surface correspondence reduces object trajectory and action-outcome prediction errors, including on unseen objects and real data.

hf_papers.title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation

hf_papers.title: SEEK: Self-Evolution through Execution Knowledge for Agentic Robot Manipulation
hf_papers.abstract: SEEK retains executable manipulation procedures and measured action effects across attempts, enabling fixed foundation-model robots to improve without retraining.

hf_papers.title: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
hf_papers.abstract: LeadVLA is a structured multimodal policy that separates route execution into explicit path, pace, and residual components, trained and evaluated with generated closed-loop data and a benchmark, achieving the highest success among tested robot policies and transferring to unseen real environments without fine-tuning.

hf_papers.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
hf_papers.abstract: Model-driven context management through a context API improves accuracy and token efficiency over harness-triggered compaction, while reusing KV caches after edits reduces prefill compute.

hf_papers.title: RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis
hf_papers.abstract: Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. hf_papers.title: From Points to Trajectories: Rethinking Multimodal Alignment for Physical Events
hf_papers.abstract: Advancing physical artificial intelligence (Physical AI) requires moving beyond static object recognition to ground how real-world mechanics (e.g., impact, friction, and force transfer) unfold over time. hf_papers.title: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
hf_papers.abstract: iMFPO enables efficient one-step action generation for embodied control by decoupling velocity learning and aligning drift-aware velocities during reward-driven policy optimization.

hf_papers.title: Beyond Code and Pixels: Co-Generating Editable and Visually Rich Presentations
hf_papers.abstract: SlidesWeaver combines language and vision agents with diffusion-based planning and shared state to generate editable, high-quality PPTX presentations while preserving native text and layout.

hf_papers.title: LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition
hf_papers.abstract: LoopDVR converts pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks by selectively reusing Transformer blocks with adapters, reducing parameters while preserving accuracy.

hf_papers.title: Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models
hf_papers.abstract: Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today's language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. hf_papers.title: Mega-MMDF and DeepfakeBench-MM: Benchmarking Multimodal Deepfake Detection Across Diverse Forgery Pipelines

hf_papers.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
hf_papers.abstract: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. hf_papers.title: Prune to Expand: Training Prompt Enhancers with Less to Imitate
hf_papers.abstract: Prune to Expand (P2E) refines dense-caption supervision by selectively removing redundant sentences under a per-example deletion bound, improving prompt enhancement alignment with human preferences and visual quality over conventional dense-caption supervised fine-tuning.

hf_papers.title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
hf_papers.abstract: A generative framework reuses a frozen encoder’s intermediate representations as staged targets and shares a DiT backbone to reduce training and sampling cost while preserving image quality.

items.title: SentryWard 形式化验证 warp 专用 GPU 内核

items.title: PipeAxes 拆开流水线服务的计算与通信粒度
items.summary: 流水线并行可以在 PCIe 服务器和异构 GPU 集群上服务长上下文模型。现有引擎用 token 分块限制解码停顿，但分块大小同时决定了 GPU 批宽和阶段之间的激活传输。PipeAxes 把计算粒度和通信粒度拆开。

items.title: 非对称投机解码改草稿模型的上下文
items.summary: 投机解码先起草再并行验证，但推理任务上的实际加速远低于理论。论文把原因归为任务同构：草稿模型和目标模型收到同一份提示，草稿模型被迫去解超出自身能力的题。

items.title: RankCast 按阶段平衡 MoE 的专家并行
items.summary: MoE 服务已经把预填充和解码拆开，并用专家并行。每一层仍要等最忙的那个 EP rank，而两个阶段的主要延迟来源并不相同。RankCast 按阶段做 rank 负载均衡。

items.title: MemOnce 改长程推理的记忆状态
items.summary: 长程交互需要可复用的记忆状态。标准 Transformer 按 token 堆积 KV cache，显存随上下文线性增长，计算更接近二次。MemOnce 把可扩展的记忆架构当作推理系统问题来做。

items.title: Any-Rate 用半比特做多精度量化
items.summary: 嵌套多精度量化只读权重的高位，就能从同一检查点得到多种精度，适合在不同内存和能耗预算下部署。现有方法只有整数比特，相邻精度落差大，2 bit 掉点严重。Any-Rate 用编码比特平面做半比特多精度。

items.title: OpenAI 预印本把矩阵乘法指数写成 9/4
items.summary: OpenAI 在 GitHub 放出数学预印本，标题写矩阵乘法指数为 9/4，路径标明 2026 年 11 月 24 日。Hacker News 讨论达到 1067 分。这是复杂度结果，不是已经进库的 GEMM 内核。

items.title: Kolpona 不靠梯度训练改进 RTL 模型
items.summary: 开源 RTL 模型通常靠在经过验证的 Verilog 语料上微调，这需要大量设计和 GPU 训练。Kolpona 用智能体框架，在不做梯度训练的情况下改进这类模型，核心是一种写进权重空间的神经元编程。

items.title: NEVA 用自然语言协同演化微架构
items.summary: 已有的 LLM 微架构搜索多半在改 C++ 仿真器代码，而不是直接讨论微架构本身。NEVA 让模型用自然语言协同演化和验证微架构设计。

items.title: AMD 专用 llama.cpp 分支
items.summary: 一篇面向 AMD 的 llama.cpp 分支被放到 Hacker News，讨论达到 436 分。它是本地推理后端的硬件分支，不是新的数据中心服务框架。

items.title: RTX Spark 紧凑台式机开卖
items.summary: 华硕、戴尔和微星的 RTX Spark 紧凑台式机已经开卖，面向本地智能体、图像与视频生成以及模型微调。统一内存最高 128GB，并带英伟达的 AI 软件栈。

items.title: SC26 推出四节点 DGX Spark 开发套件
items.summary: 本周芝加哥 SC26 上，英伟达推出 DGX Spark HPC 开发者套件：四台 DGX Spark 组成集群，每台与相邻两台直接连成环。

items.title: MixMoMo 在手机 GPU 和 NPU 上跑超大 MoE
items.summary: 手机上的 MoE 靠稀疏专家扩大容量，但细粒度专家一多，加载和计算都变难。MixMoMo 用混合精度，把超大 MoE 的推理拆到移动端 GPU 和 NPU 上一起跑。

items.title: 超微无风扇 Panther Lake 边缘整机
items.summary: ServeTheHome 评测超微 SYS-E103-14P-H。这是一台无风扇边缘设备，处理器为英特尔 Panther Lake Core Ultra X7 368H，并带较密的工业接口。

funding.title: 闪科光联完成数千万元天使轮
funding.summary: 雷锋网报道，MicroLED 高速光互连芯片与光引擎公司闪科光联完成数千万元人民币天使轮，由商汤国香、长石资本、厚雪资本联合领投。金额是报道中的区间，不是精确到个位的公告数字。

funding.title: 索尼分拆公司 Altair 据报融资约 1 亿美元
funding.summary: Data Center Dynamics 报道，索尼分拆的 Altair 以约 1 亿美元融资做边缘 AI 连接，芯片组已在和爱立信测试，方向转向可穿戴设备上的 AI。金额来自报道。

funding.title: 商汤大装置 Token 工厂拿到信通院最高评级
funding.summary: 量子位报道，商汤大装置 Token 工厂获得中国信通院 Token 工厂智算能力评估的「全栈服务型·领先级」，并称是全国首批首家。这是能力评级，不是一轮融资。

funding.title: Anthropic 上市后股价跌破发行价
funding.summary: TechCrunch 报道 Anthropic 上市后的股价跌破发行价，并认为这会给 AI 初创公司的估值带来压力。报道没有给出可核对的募资余额，这里不写金额。
